leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a base function that returns a typed array of query key segments.
Construct a typed query key factory by extending the base function with a nested structure.
Apply the factory to generate specific, type-safe query keys for different data resources.
Integrate the typed query key factory with a mock query function to demonstrate type safety.
Manipulate the factory to produce keys for nested routes or IDs.
Configure the factory to accept and enforce parameters for dynamic query keys.
Update existing untyped key arrays to use the new typed factory for improved developer experience.
